en: Color view of a large historic square with a central stone-domed building in the background, a tall dark plague column or religious monument on the left, and a prominent equestrian statue on a stone pedestal on the right. People sit on benches and steps in the foreground, with 1960s-era cars and buses visible near the buildings. The architecture blends Ottoman-style domed masonry with Central European civic buildings.
